text.b01: [excited] Hiya! I'm Bon-chan the lantern! Tonight YOU are the lantern keeper!
text.b02: [playful] All the ghosts in this house are little pranksters. Nothing scary!
text.b03: [curious] But ghosts are chilly. When one comes close, that ear goes cold.
text.b04: [excited] Then turn me that way! My light is warm, so the ghosts run away!
text.b05: [whispers] …There, your left ear. Felt that chill?
text.b06: [laughs] Yay! It ran off! Just like that!
text.b07: [excited] Next, the corridor! Ghosts from the right and the left, faster and faster!
text.b08: [happy] Oh, candies! Pick them up! We'll share them later!
text.b09: [surprised] Whoa, it touched you! So cold! …It's fine, we can still do this!
text.b10: [whispers] …Shh. This is the tatami room. They sometimes come from behind the sliding doors.
text.b11: [serious] If both ears go cold, it's behind you! Hold me up high!
text.b12: [curious] …Huh? That might have been just the draught and the wind chime. Did you hear giggling?
text.b14: [nervous] …Next, the old storehouse. It's pitch dark. Only my light.
text.b15: [whispers] You can close your eyes. Listen with your ears, feel with your ears.
text.b16: [excited] Amazing! You chased them all off in the dark! You're a genius!
text.y02: [whispers] …I'm cold, aren't I. That's why everyone runs away.
text.y04b: [softly] …You're not scared? …Thank you. [happy] Everyone, come out!
text.b17: [excited] Look, look, fireworks! You can see the festival fireworks from the window!
text.b18: [proud] Ehehe, right?! …Come again. Next summer, you're the lantern keeper too!
